description: Individual (1:1) lash extensions and semi-permanent make-up for brows, lips and eyeliner at AnyLopez aesthetic clinic in Benidorm. Pre-design and conservative technique that ages well.

jsonld.name: AnyLopez Lash Extensions & Semi-Permanent Make-up
jsonld.description: Lash extensions and semi-permanent make-up catalogue at AnyLopez Aesthetic Clinic Benidorm: individual (1:1) lash extensions and semi-permanent make-up for brows, lips and eyeliner. Pre-design, durable hypoallergenic pigments and a conservative technique that ages well.

faq.q: How long do individual lash extensions last?
faq.a: Between 3 and 4 weeks, depending on your natural lash cycle. We schedule a top-up every 3-4 weeks to keep volume consistent. No damage to your natural lashes.
Mild discomfort, not pain. We apply numbing cream before and during the session. Most patients describe the sensation as a brief tingling or pinch.

faq.q: When should I have my semi-permanent make-up touched up?
faq.a: Initial top-up at 4-6 weeks (after the healing process) to refine the result. After that, annual top-ups to maintain colour and intensity.
Hypoallergenic pigments, but we always run an allergy patch test on a small area beforehand. If you react, we don't apply.
After the session: 7 days with no direct sun, no saunas, no sea/pool water and no make-up over the area. After that you can carry on as normal — daily SPF is key for the pigment to last.

pain.eyebrow: Does any of this sound familiar?
pain.h2: Most patients who come here have been through the same.
pain.p_html: You're not arriving from nowhere. You're arriving after trying other things that never quite worked.

items.h3_html: You wake up looking tired before your routine even starts.
items.p_html: Pale brows, sparse lashes, dull lips. You step out without make-up and the face in the mirror isn't really you.

items.h3_html: Drawing on brows and lips every morning steals minutes you don't have.

why.eyebrow_html: Why lash extensions & semi-permanent make-up at AnyLopez work
why.h2_html: Six reasons it works here when it doesn't elsewhere.
why.p_html: It isn't marketing. It's pre-design, conservative technique and pigments that age well.

items.p_html: Before applying anything, we draw on your skin and validate the shape with you. If you're not convinced, we don't begin.

items.h3: Individual (1:1) lash extensions, no artificial fans.
items.p_html: One synthetic lash for each natural lash. Real volume, a natural look — no "doll lash" effect.
Trademarked, traceable brands — not pigments from an online shop. Colour that ages well, without turning red or grey over the years.
Better a little pigment now plus a top-up than overloading. Better lashes that respect your natural lash than extensions that damage it.
We book your top-ups at the right cadence (lashes every 3-4 weeks, semi-permanent make-up an annual top-up). We don't drop you after the sale.

items.h3: Applied by a certified, experienced professional.
